Hello, I’m Chidiebube.

Thanks for stopping by. I’m a brand and product designer with an engineering background. For five years I’ve helped companies in the UAE, St. Lucia and Nigeria look and feel like themselves, from the logo to the landing page.

I start with research: who the audience is, what the business needs and what the competition is doing. Then I turn that into identities, interfaces and marketing material that stay consistent everywhere.

I also train new designers in UI/UX, and I finished my MBA at Miva Open University in 2026 with distinction, so I think about the business side of design too.

If you’re building something you care about, I’d love to hear about it.

Cheers,

Chidiebube
